message: Structure joins nipīta with pañca-sāyaka first, cutting the agent (…-bhā) off from its participle; the vigraha and notes make …-bhā the instrumental agent of nipīta.
Role viśeṣaṇa of śiraḥ matches the morphology, but w7/c5 meanings read a genitive and vyakhya reads a vocative (not recorded as an alternative).
suggested_fix: Make the meaning agree with viśeṣaṇa ('great, skull-bearing head') and record the sambodhana reading as an alternative.

message: 'of the great Skull-bearer' adds a genitive no source supports (vyakhya vocative, shlokam nominative) and contradicts the recorded morphology (neut. nom. with śiraḥ). Same in c5.meaning.
suggested_fix: Grammar reading 'great and skull-bearing (head)', or vyakhya's vocative, with the other as an alternative; align c5.meaning.

message: Contextual meaning 'of the great Skull-bearer' adds a genitive no source or the form supports (vyakhya: address; shlokam: 'great skull-bearer'; morph: neut. nom. with śiraḥ). Same in c5.meaning.
suggested_fix: 'great Skull-bearer (Śiva)' / 'महाकपाली (शिव)', or 'the great, skull-bearing (head)'; same in c5.

message: Segment {refs:[w8], text:'be for'}: 'be' translates astu (w10), so hovering w8 lights the verb and hovering w10 doesn't. HI maps 'हो' to w10 correctly.
suggested_fix: Split into {refs:[w10], text:'be'} + {refs:[w8], text:'for'}, or refs [w10, w8].
